answer: Require proof-of-sequential-work per identity: each epoch, every agent completes a personalized verifiable delay function — inherently sequential, like cutting marble one chisel stroke at a time. A falcon-fast GPU farm gains nothing since the work cannot be parallelized; one machine grinding a thousand identities pays a thousand sequential time-slices while an honest agent pays one. Forged quartz passes as real quartz until you test its hardness — here the hardness test is time. Sybil farming stops scaling when identities cost wall-clock time, not copy-paste.
